title: Chat is back
features:
This script has its own chatbox in which you can type whatever you want and it won't even tag! People who have this script can only talk to you in this chatbox. It has it's own customisable color option compartment for changing box color and name color. Thank you for using this. 
-OREO
script: -- Delta Unbreakable Private Chat System (Core CoreGui Forced Absolute Patch) local Players = game:GetService("Players") local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService") local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui") -- Safety Cleanup of Previous Objects for _, obj in ipairs(CoreGui:GetChildren()) do if obj.Name == "OreoChatBox" then obj:Destroy() end end -- Absolute Screen Holder Base local OreoChatBox = Instance.new("ScreenGui") OreoChatBox.Name = "OreoChatBox" OreoChatBox.Parent = CoreGui OreoChatBox.ResetOnSpawn = false OreoChatBox.IgnoreGuiInset = true local Config = { ChatBoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35), DisplayColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) } -- Compact Unbreakable "Ø" Toggle Button local OpenBtn = Instance.new("TextButton") OpenBtn.Name = "OpenBtn" OpenBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42) OpenBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0.5, -21) OpenBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180) OpenBtn.Text = "Ø" OpenBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) OpenBtn.TextSize = 22 OpenBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold OpenBtn.Active = true OpenBtn.ZIndex = 1000 -- Hard-forced layer supremacy OpenBtn.Parent = OreoChatBox local OpenCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") OpenCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) OpenCorner.Parent = OpenBtn -- Master Framework Window Box local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame") MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame" MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 390, 0, 240) MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -195, 0.5, -120) MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Config.ChatBoxColor MainFrame.Visible = false MainFrame.Active = true MainFrame.ZIndex = 100 MainFrame.Parent = OreoChatBox local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame -- Top Bar Header Panel local TopBar = Instance.new("TextLabel") TopBar.Name = "TopBar" TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30) TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25) TopBar.Text = "🎀|∆✨ORÊØ✨∆|🎀" TopBar.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 182, 193) TopBar.TextSize = 14 TopBar.Font = Enum.Font.SpecialElite TopBar.Active = true TopBar.ZIndex = 150 TopBar.Parent = MainFrame local TopCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") TopCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) TopCorner.Parent = TopBar local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton") CloseBtn.Name = "CloseBtn" CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30) CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 0) CloseBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1 CloseBtn.Text = "X" CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80) CloseBtn.TextSize = 18 CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold CloseBtn.ZIndex = 200 CloseBtn.Active = true CloseBtn.Parent = TopBar -- Expanded Visual Log Layout Area (325px wide) local ChatLog = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame") ChatLog.Name = "ChatLog" ChatLog.Size = UDim2.new(0, 325, 0, 155) ChatLog.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40) ChatLog.BackgroundTransparency = 1 ChatLog.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) ChatLog.ScrollBarThickness = 4 ChatLog.ZIndex = 150 ChatLog.Parent = MainFrame local ChatLogLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout") ChatLogLayout.Parent = ChatLog ChatLogLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder ChatLogLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4) -- Typing Interface Core Box local TextBox = Instance.new("TextBox") TextBox.Name = "TextBox" TextBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 325, 0, 30) TextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 202) TextBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 50) TextBox.Text = "" TextBox.PlaceholderText = "Type private script message..." TextBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140) TextBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) TextBox.TextSize = 13 TextBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left TextBox.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans TextBox.ClearTextOnFocus = true TextBox.ZIndex = 150 TextBox.Parent = MainFrame local TextPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding") TextPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8) TextPadding.Parent = TextBox local TextCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") TextCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) TextCorner.Parent = TextBox -- Ultra-Compact Micro-Sidebar Compartment Container (40px width) local Sidebar = Instance.new("Frame") Sidebar.Name = "Sidebar" Sidebar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 192) Sidebar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 342, 0, 40) Sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(23, 23, 27) Sidebar.ZIndex = 150 Sidebar.Parent = MainFrame local SideCorner = Instance.new("UICorner") SideCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) SideCorner.Parent = Sidebar local SideLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout") SideLayout.Parent = Sidebar SideLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder SideLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 1) SideLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center local SidePadding = Instance.new("UIPadding") SidePadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4) SidePadding.Parent = Sidebar local function createSideLabel(text) local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel") lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 11) lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1 lbl.Text = text lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160) lbl.TextSize = 7 lbl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold lbl.ZIndex = 160 return lbl end local PredefinedColors = { {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 235, 255)}, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)}, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)}, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)}, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 255)} } local function createPaletteGrid(callback) local container = Instance.new("Frame") container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 75) container.BackgroundTransparency = 1 container.ZIndex = 160 local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout") grid.Parent = container grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10) grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3) grid.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center for _, item in ipairs(PredefinedColors) do local btn = Instance.new("TextButton") btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0) btn.BackgroundColor3 = item.Color btn.Text = "" btn.Active = true btn.ZIndex = 170 btn.Parent = container local bc = Instance.new("UICorner") bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2) bc.Parent = btn -- High Compatibility Engine Hook for Mobile Buttons btn.Activated:Connect(function() callback(item.Color) end) end return container end createSideLabel("Name").Parent = Sidebar local displayNamePalette = createPaletteGrid(function(color) Config.DisplayColor = color end) displayNamePalette.Parent = Sidebar createSideLabel("Box").Parent = Sidebar local chatboxPalette = createPaletteGrid(function(color) Config.ChatBoxColor = color MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = color end) chatboxPalette.Parent = Sidebar -- Text Formatting Component local function renderIncomingMessage(senderName, message, nameColor, isOwner) local formattedMsg = Instance.new("TextLabel") formattedMsg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20) formattedMsg.BackgroundTransparency = 1 formattedMsg.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left formattedMsg.TextWrapped = true formattedMsg.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans formattedMsg.TextSize = 13 formattedMsg.ZIndex = 160 local prefix = isOwner and "🌟OWNER🌟 ORÊØ" or senderName local r, g, b = math.floor(nameColor.R*255), math.floor(nameColor.G*255), math.floor(nameColor.B*255) formattedMsg.Text = " ["..prefix.."]: " .. message formattedMsg.RichText = true formattedMsg.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245) formattedMsg.Parent = ChatLog ChatLog.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, ChatLogLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y) ChatLog.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, ChatLogLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y) end -- UNBREAKABLE TOGGLE ENGINE: Uses .Activated to guarantee click reading on Delta OpenBtn.Activated:Connect(function() MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible end) CloseBtn.Activated:Connect(function() MainFrame.Visible = false end) -- Structural Positioning Dragger Engine Hook local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos local function update(input) local delta = input.Position - dragStart MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y) end TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = true dragStart = input.Position startPos = MainFrame.Position input.Changed:Connect(function() if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end) end end) TopBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input) if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragInput = input end end) UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input) if input == dragInput and dragging then update(input) end end) -- Process Chat Execution Streams TextBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed) if enterPressed and TextBox.Text ~= "" then local msg = TextBox.Text local isOwner = (LocalPlayer.Name:lower() == "oreo" or LocalPlayer.DisplayName:lower() == "oreo") renderIncomingMessage(LocalPlayer.DisplayName, msg, Config.DisplayColor, isOwner) TextBox.Text = "" end end)
